# Poषण

> Poषण ("foods that heal") is a small-batch food brand rooted in Ayurvedic tradition — clean ingredients, traditional methods, no exaggerated health claims.

Poषण makes fermented and traditional foods: probiotic kefir, lacto-fermented pickles, and traditional millet-based treats. Every product is made in small batches with no ultra-processed ingredients, and is described in plain, factual terms — storage, shelf life, and ingredients are listed on each product page rather than made with health claims.

## Products

- [All products](https://www.poshan.example/#products): The current catalog of Poषण's small-batch foods, with ingredients, storage, and nutrition facts per product.
